name: Neris Canals
story_spaces: Ceremonial castle approach and four cross-canals
Public water gardens beside the relay tower
Paired repair-market streets and quiet residential banks

name: Neris Star Lake
story_spaces: Eight luminous bridge spokes across a vast reservoir
An island palace and circular civic promenade
Relay maintenance gardens and an outer ring of homes

name: Neris Crown Isles
story_spaces: Nine garden islands separated by deep, clear waterways
Long illuminated processional bridges
Royal island, market quays and southern residential villages

name: East Valley
story_spaces: Castle-free relief village with a public City Hall
Modest homes, paired orchards and practical market shelters
Quiet gardens for the East Valley memorial and resident-ledger scenes

name: Orin's Village
story_spaces: Working label for Orin's unnamed home village; not a new canon proper name
Castle-free City Hall, family homes and armor-repair stalls
Twin garden lakes, intimate bridges and a lantern-ring promenade

name: Neris Spaceport
story_spaces: Orbital welcome gardens and eight illuminated approach bridges
Embassy pavilions, arrival plaza and water observatories
Original terminal, doors, pads and alien arrival schedules retained

name: Horizon Airport
story_spaces: Scalloped coastline and repeated sheltered lagoons
Twin circular arrival villages and tree-lined perimeter drive
Operating terminal, runway, aircraft and navigation beacons retained

name: Verdant Reach
story_spaces: A wooded journey from the waterworks toward the eastern settlements.
Three clearings reserved for encounters; monster spawning is separate gameplay.

name: Greyglass Pass
story_spaces: Rocky switchback route linking the forest to East Valley.
Mountains are solid scenery; walking paths remain level and collision tested.

name: Sunglass Expanse
story_spaces: An exposed desert route with a sheltered oasis and ruined waymarks.
Working geography for Luma; space reserved for travel encounters.

name: Neris Waterworks
story_spaces: Chapter One waterworks: paired settling basins, pump platforms and service lanes.
Industrial machinery and scripted disaster sequence remain separate story work.

name: Ancient Relay
story_spaces: Chapter One ancient relay exterior; radial maintenance paths and weathered spires.
Not the separate Chapter Five off-world observatory.

name: Neris Relief Quarter
story_spaces: Chapter One clinic and relief staging: medical hall, supply stalls and modest homes.
Architecture is draft staging; does not replace accepted character or story canon.
